title: The Mourning Fields
_note: Lane N3 (walkthrough/11 Part C). A farm lullaby slowed into a hush for the fields where the Hollowing put the field-kin to sleep. snes register, 3/4 sway, D minor, 84 bpm, 32 bars (A B A' C). Vesper motif TENDER-BUT-WITHHELD: the lift A3-D4-E4 overshoots every phrase and the settle lands on the dominant, never quite home (the Hollowing-zone rule, softened: they are asleep, not gone). Music-box pluck = the sleepers; strings low and thin; a bell at each phrase end; a faint hat drip, no beat. Last bar hangs on E over A and falls back into the lift.
